# GUI Interface Description

## System Overview
- Operating System: Linux (likely Ubuntu or a derivative)
- Desktop Environment: GNOME
- Date and Time: October 23, 17:40
- System Status Icons: Present in top-right corner (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Background
- Color Scheme: Gradient from deep purple to orange-red
- Design: Abstract, geometric, low-poly style with flowing, feather-like shapes
- Visual Style: Modern, minimalist, with sharp angular elements

## Application Window
- Application: Terminal (Activities > Terminal)
- Window Title: `user@user-virtual-machine: ~`
- Window Controls: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in top-right
- Terminal Interface:
  - Background Color: Dark purple
  - Text Color: Light (likely white or light gray)
  - Prompt: `user@user-virtual-machine:~$`
  - Command History:
    - `epub-decrypt -x ProtectedBook.epubProtectedBook.key`
    - `pub-decrypt -k ProtectedBook.epubProtectedBook.key`
    - `epub-decrypt -p ProtectedBook.epub`
    - `epub/home/user/Downloads/drm_epub_bundle`
    - `epub-decrypt -k ProtectedBook.epub`
    - `epub-decrypt -k ProtectedBook.epub`

## Desktop Panel
- Left Dock (Vertical Application Launcher):
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - Files (File Manager)
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (Question Mark)
  - Terminal (currently active)
  - Trash
  - App Grid (9-dot grid icon)
- Top Bar:
  - Left: Activities button
  - Center: "Terminal" label
  - Right: Date/time and system icons

## Desktop Icons
- Bottom-right corner: Home folder icon with "Home" label

## Terminal Window Details
- Terminal Title Bar: `user@user-virtual-machine: ~`
- Terminal Controls: Search, Menu, Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons
- Terminal Content:
  - User prompt: `user@user-virtual-machine:~$`
  - Command line: `epub-decrypt -x ProtectedBook.epubProtectedBook.key`
  - Command line: `pub-decrypt -k ProtectedBook.epubProtectedBook.key`
  - Command line: `epub-decrypt -p ProtectedBook.epub`
  - Command line: `epub/home/user/Downloads/drm_epub_bundle`
  - Command line: `epub-decrypt -k ProtectedBook.epub`
  - Command line: `epub-decrypt -k ProtectedBook.epub`
- Scrollbar: Visible on the right side of the terminal window

## Visual Design Elements
- Color Palette: Dominated by purples and reds
- Typography: Clean, sans-serif fonts
- Layout: Symmetrical, with clear separation between application window and desktop background
- Icons: Flat design with subtle shadows and highlights

## System Status
- No visible notifications or alerts
- System appears idle with no active processes visible
- No error messages or warnings displayed

## User Interface Components
- Window Management: Standard GNOME window controls
- Application Launcher: Vertical dock on left side
- Desktop Navigation: Home folder icon for quick access
- System Monitoring: Date and time displayed in top bar
- Search Functionality: Search icon in terminal window

## Functional Elements
- Terminal: Active and ready for input
- File Management: Home folder icon accessible
- Application Launch: Dock provides quick access to common applications
- System Control: Power and sound icons for system settings

## Layout and Composition
- Terminal window centered on the desktop
- Dock occupies left edge of screen
- Desktop background fills remaining space
- Icons positioned at bottom-right corner
- Top bar spans entire width of screen

## Visual Hierarchy
- Terminal window is the primary focus
- Dock provides secondary access to applications
- Desktop background serves as visual backdrop
- System status icons are tertiary elements
- Home folder icon is a quick-access element

## Interaction Elements
- Terminal prompt indicates user can input commands
- Dock icons are clickable for launching applications
- Window controls allow resizing and closing
- System icons provide quick access to settings
- Home folder icon allows navigation to user directory

## Design Consistency
- Uniform color scheme across all elements
- Consistent icon design language
- Standardized window controls
- Predictable layout structure
- Clean, uncluttered interface

## Accessibility Features
- High contrast between text and background
- Clear, readable fonts
- Standardized iconography
- Logical layout for easy navigation
- Accessible window controls

## Technical Details
- Terminal application
